from.place: Proof Step 2, "etale morphisms are weakly etale, hence covering families in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]": the jointly surjective etale family is a pro-etale cover

title: Etale covering families are pro-etale covering families
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and let $\{u_i:U_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ be a jointly surjective family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then this family is a pro-etale covering family of $T$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site].
